name: manual_cf4eac
claim: Private owner identity and forbidden-attribution literals must never be hardcoded in any tracked repository file, test, memory entry, documentation, commit message, or local git metadata. Keep the rule and loader in-repo, but keep the actual literals in the OpenClaw workspace-root local-only verboten file and compare them case-insensitively.

decisions.notes: The earlier fix still embedded private literals in allowlists and tests, which violated the policy it was trying to enforce. The durable pattern is externalized private literals plus generic in-repo loaders and synthetic test fixtures.
